'''Marc Ferré Nazzaro''' (born 11 January 1994) is an Andorran international [[association football|footballer]] who plays for [[Penya Encarnada d'Andorra|Penya Encardana]] as a [[midfielder]].

==Career==
Born in [[Andorra la Vella]], Ferré has played club football for [[FC Andorra]].<ref name = "NFT">{{NFT player|pid=71331|accessdate=16 November 2018}}</ref>

He made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2018.<ref name = "NFT"/>
